name: cable standing single arm supinated grip chest press
description: A standing one-arm press with a palm-up grip that works the chest and tests core stability.
instructions: Set a cable at chest height and hold the handle with a palm-up grip.
Stand facing away in a staggered stance.
Press the handle forward until your arm is straight.
Keep your torso still and resist twisting.
Return slowly and switch arms after your reps.
